reasons.text: Claimed tonnage in the busiest month would need 243% of the plant's connected load running non-stop (above 100% is physically impossible)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 100% of months
Electricity bought is only 0.20x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (31 kWh/t against at least 150)
Sold products equal only 18% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 1 other plant(s)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.28x the cost floor)

model_signals.label: months with output far below input

inspection_checklist: Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
